definitions: A genus of medium-sized birds of prey in the family Accipitridae, commonly known as kites.
The scientific name for various species of kites, such as the red kite (Milvus milvus) and the black kite (Milvus migrans).
examples: The genus Milvus includes several species of kites.
Milvus milvus is native to Europe and parts of Asia.
Observations of Milvus species are common in this region.
